blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—On Friday, the law firm representing Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa questioned the legal basis of the P50-million bounty for the senator’s arrest. Torreon and Partners asked in a statement posted in their official Facebook page: “Every peso of a government reward must answer one question – for the arrest of whom, in what case, by order of what court?” “The DILG does not grant rewards by press conference. It grants them through Memorandum Circulars covering ‘Most Wanted Persons,” the lawyers explained. The senator’s defense team pointed out that the DILG’s own reward protocol requires a valid Philippine arrest warrant […]...
